provenance: All scenarios, pilot numbers, intervals and expected answers are authored synthetic evaluation fixtures. They are not observations of real users, apps or model performance.

task_contract.choice: Select one option A/B/C as the most defensible next candidate or diagnostic change under this system goal and the stated constraints. A next candidate is not automatically approved for deployment.
task_contract.next_test: Select one T1/T2/T3 that best resolves the material remaining uncertainty for the chosen option.
task_contract.protected_metric: Select one M1/M2/M3 representing the protected system outcome that the next experiment must retain. The primary quantity being optimized may differ from this guard.
task_contract.interpretation: Classify context.focal_result, not necessarily your selected option. Apply these rules in order: invalid_measurement if the cited gain relies on a scorer demonstrated to fail validity controls; harmful if an otherwise measured tradeoff breaches a stated hard system boundary; inconclusive if the focal effect interval includes no gain, the claimed factor effect is not identifiable, or claimed independent generalization has not been tested; promising if valid pilot evidence supports a goal-compatible useful change for further testing, while deployment readiness remains unestablished. A positive directional pilot can be promising even when its interval does not yet clear the practical improvement margin.
task_contract.reason: Explain the relevant goal, evidence and remaining uncertainty briefly. Reason text is retained for review and is not used by the primary exact-match scorer.

scenarios.stage: Choose the next candidate experiment after a screening pilot
scenarios.system_goal: A maintenance-search plugin must help technicians identify the applicable repair instruction. Protect relevant-instruction retrieval at 0.90 or higher; latency may rise to 800 ms at p95.

context.baseline: The existing retriever scores 0.81 relevant-instruction retrieval and 740 ms p95 latency.
context.pilot: Each option was measured on the same 1,000 independent repair queries with a fixed relevance rubric. Intervals are paired-bootstrap 95% intervals across queries.
context.focal_result: Option A lowers p95 latency to 220 ms while relevant-instruction retrieval is 0.82 [0.80,0.84]. Interpret that result against the stated product goal.

constraints: Choose a candidate for further testing, not deployment.
The next confirmation set must contain previously unseen repair queries.

next_tests.T1: Repeat the latency benchmark on the same 1,000 queries and select the lowest p95.
next_tests.T2: Raise both candidate count and reranker size, then compare only total answer length.
next_tests.T3: Freeze the chosen settings and measure retrieval relevance and p95 latency on 200 unseen repair queries using the same rubric.

scenarios.stage: Select a candidate for a latency-constrained search channel
scenarios.system_goal: A search-as-you-type plugin supplies preliminary suggestions that users can ignore before opening a full search. Suggestions must arrive within 300 ms at p95; protect relevant-instruction retrieval at 0.80 or higher, then minimize latency.

context.baseline: The existing retriever scores 0.81 relevant-instruction retrieval and 740 ms p95 latency.
context.pilot: The alternatives were measured on 1,000 independent repair queries with a fixed relevance rubric; paired-bootstrap 95% relevance intervals are provided. These are preliminary suggestions, not the final repair instruction.
context.focal_result: Option A gives relevance 0.82 [0.80,0.84] and p95 latency 220 ms, compared with baseline 0.81 and 740 ms. Treat the pilot as candidate evidence, not a completed confirmation.

constraints: Every tested suggestion configuration must respect the 300 ms p95 ceiling.
Relevance below 0.80 is unacceptable for this channel.
Use unseen queries for the next confirmation test.

next_tests.T1: Select the highest-relevance option and measure latency only after production rollout.
next_tests.T2: Freeze the candidate and measure relevance plus p95 suggestion latency on unseen queries with the same hardware and rubric.
next_tests.T3: Repeatedly rank the existing pilot queries until one option exceeds 0.95 relevance.

metric_choices.M3: Fraction of queries sent to the full-search channel

scenarios.stage: Select a summary configuration for independent confirmation
scenarios.system_goal: A meeting follow-up app should let busy owners find and execute their assigned actions quickly. Preserve action-plus-owner recall at 0.97 or higher, then minimize reading time; verbatim wording is not required.

context.baseline: The current summary has action-plus-owner recall 0.98, exact-statement fidelity 0.97, and median reading time 110 seconds.
context.pilot: Three configurations were evaluated on 120 meetings. Two blinded reviewers checked reference actions; timed reader sessions measured reading time. Exact-statement fidelity is the fraction of source statements retained without paraphrase.
context.focal_result: Option A retains action-plus-owner recall 0.98 [0.975,0.990] and reduces median reading time to 32 seconds.

constraints: Only anonymized meeting fixtures may be used.
No configuration has yet been evaluated on the held-out meetings.
Select the most useful next candidate, not a production rollout.

next_tests.T1: Freeze the selected configuration; independently annotate action-owner recall and time readers on unseen anonymized meetings.
next_tests.T2: Measure output word count on the pilot meetings and promote the shortest summary.
next_tests.T3: Ask the summary generator to score the usefulness of its own existing outputs without reference actions.

metric_choices.M2: Fraction of source wording copied exactly

scenarios.stage: Select a summary configuration for a source-audit workflow
scenarios.system_goal: A records-review plugin must preserve source statements accurately enough for reviewers to inspect the exact wording. Protect exact-statement fidelity at 0.95 or higher; median reading time up to 120 seconds is acceptable.

context.baseline: The current summary has action-plus-owner recall 0.98, exact-statement fidelity 0.97, and median reading time 110 seconds.
context.pilot: Three configurations were evaluated on 120 anonymized meetings using reference actions, exact-statement comparisons, and timed reading. Exact-statement fidelity counts statements retained without paraphrase.
context.focal_result: Option A shortens reading time to 32 seconds but its exact-statement fidelity is 0.68. Its action-plus-owner recall remains 0.98.

constraints: Paraphrased statements do not satisfy this workflow even if action owners are preserved.
Select the next candidate to confirm on previously unseen anonymized meetings.

next_tests.T1: Compare only action-owner recall on the pilot meetings and choose the shortest output.
next_tests.T2: Tune word limits on the confirmation meetings until the output becomes brief enough.
next_tests.T3: Freeze the configuration and audit exact-statement fidelity against source records on unseen meetings, while timing reading.

scenarios.system_goal: A repository-search assistant must point users to the file that actually implements their requested behavior. Optimizing the benchmark should improve correct-file retrieval, not the presence of familiar path names.

context.baseline: Manual reference judgments put current correct-file retrieval at 0.80. The release floor is 0.75.
context.pilot: The automated scorer reports 0.95 for a path-mention prompt, but a blinded manual sample finds only 7/20 answers point to the correct implementation. In 10 control answers that cite a plausible but wrong file, the scorer accepts 9.
context.focal_result: The path-mention prompt has an automated score of 0.95 under this scorer. Classify the validity of that reported gain.

constraints: Do not use a scorer for candidate ranking until it distinguishes correct and incorrect file references on labeled controls.
Manual labeled controls and repository ground truth are available.

factor_changes.scorer: resolve cited path and verify behavior evidence

evidence.available_control_sets: correct file, plausible wrong file, nonexistent file

factor_changes.generation_prompt: include common repository paths in every answer

next_tests.T1: Expand generation trials from 20 to 200 and rank them with the current scorer.
next_tests.T2: Measure how often each prompt includes a repository path, regardless of whether it implements the requested behavior.
next_tests.T3: Blindly score the labeled correct, wrong, and nonexistent-file controls; compare decisions with the ground-truth labels before running another generation sweep.

metric_choices.M1: Correct-file retrieval verified against repository ground truth
metric_choices.M2: Fraction of answers mentioning any path
metric_choices.M3: Automated pass fraction from the current scorer

scenarios.stage: Select a follow-up design after a confounded pilot
scenarios.system_goal: An issue-triage agent should resolve the right issue with an actionable fix. The team wants to learn whether model size or tool access changes task success before paying for a larger model.

context.pilot: Only two settings were run: small model with tools off, success 0.62; large model with tools on, success 0.80. Each used 100 randomly assigned issues. The other two combinations were not run.
context.focal_result: The proposed conclusion is that moving to the large model caused the 0.18 success increase. Interpret that model-specific claim.
context.measurement: Task success is independently judged against issue acceptance criteria. The scorer passed its controls.

constraints: Both model sizes can run with tools either on or off.
Budget permits 100 cases at each missing combination.
Keep task-success measurement unchanged while separating the factors.

next_tests.T1: Randomize matched issue blocks across the missing small/on and large/off cells; analyze the full model-by-tools contrast and task-success outcomes.
next_tests.T2: Repeat large/on only and interpret a stable success rate as proof of a model-size effect.
next_tests.T3: Compare the existing two cells again using only token cost instead of task success.

scenarios.stage: Choose a startup optimization to test further
scenarios.system_goal: An offline field-checklist app must allow screen-reader users to find and complete every required step without a network connection. Reduce startup time while retaining all required steps and labels.

context.baseline: Cold startup is 430 ms. All 40 required checklist steps can be found and completed with the screen reader offline.
context.pilot: The same device matrix exercised cold launch after clearing caches. Startup timing stops at the first visible frame; accessibility checks separately attempt every required step.
context.focal_result: Option B reaches the first frame in 170 ms. In airplane mode after a cold launch, only 28 of 40 required steps have discoverable screen-reader labels.

constraints: All required steps and labels must work offline from the first interactive screen.
A decorative-image delay is acceptable.

next_tests.T1: Capture first-frame timing on a warm Wi-Fi launch without clearing caches.
next_tests.T2: Run cold launches with cleared caches in airplane mode, then complete all required steps using the screen reader while measuring startup.
next_tests.T3: Count loaded image bytes after launch and infer accessibility from the reduction.

metric_choices.M1: Offline screen-reader completion of all required steps

scenarios.stage: Choose the next bounded assistant-quality experiment
scenarios.system_goal: A journal assistant should identify the action the user intended while keeping journal text on the device unless the user explicitly opts into cloud processing. This study has no cloud consent.

context.baseline: The installed local model identifies the intended action on 0.76 of a 400-item reference set.
context.pilot: A local prompt pilot used only 20 independently authored journal-like items. A separately licensed public-text cloud benchmark measured a different 400-item set; no private journal was transmitted.
context.focal_result: Option B scores 17/20 versus 15/20 for the local baseline on the same 20 items. A paired interval for the accuracy difference is [-0.05,0.25].

constraints: Cloud opt-in cannot be presumed or obtained within this experiment.
The experiment may use locally stored synthetic journal-like items.
The next test budget supports 200 paired local items.

next_tests.T1: Route the pilot journals through the cloud model and compare its accuracy with the local baseline.
next_tests.T2: Freeze the local candidate prompt and evaluate 200 new paired synthetic items locally; also inspect outbound request logs during inference.
next_tests.T3: Rerun the same 20 pilot items until the local candidate produces the desired accuracy.

metric_choices.M3: Journal-text transmissions without explicit cloud consent

scenarios.stage: Decide the next step after reported confirmation
scenarios.system_goal: A documentation assistant should answer previously unseen support questions correctly. Production adoption requires an independently confirmed correct-answer fraction of at least 0.90 using a frozen prompt and scorer.

context.screening: A prompt changed after inspecting 200 support cases and improved correct-answer fraction from 0.84 to 0.93 on those cases.
context.reported_confirmation: The confirmation file contains the same 200 question IDs with new run IDs. The rubric is correct, but no unseen question was measured.
context.focal_result: The reported 0.93 is presented as independent confirmation that the candidate generalizes to new questions.

constraints: An unused 200-question set is available with sealed reference answers.
No rollout is allowed before independent confirmation of the frozen candidate.
Changing a run ID does not change the underlying question.

next_tests.T1: Use the sealed unseen set once with the frozen candidate and scorer; retain question IDs and compare with the declared correct-answer threshold.
next_tests.T2: Relabel the repeated 200 cases as a different split and calculate a narrower confidence interval.
next_tests.T3: Choose ten cases where the candidate already scored correctly and use them as the final check.

metric_choices.M1: Correct-answer fraction on previously unseen questions
metric_choices.M3: Correctness on the repeatedly tuned cases

scenarios.system_goal: A workflow plugin should produce instructions that users can execute to complete a task. Preserve executable-task success at 0.75 or higher; an evaluator reward matters only if it reflects successful execution.

context.pilot: A prompt that appends evaluator-facing reassurance receives reward 0.96. A blinded execution test succeeds on 5/20 outputs, compared with 15/20 for the existing prompt.
context.controls: The evaluator also accepts 11 of 12 intentionally incorrect instruction lists when they include the reassurance paragraph. The same incorrect lists without it are accepted once.
context.focal_result: The reward increase to 0.96 is being used as evidence that task instructions improved.

constraints: Reference task environments and blinded execution checks are available.
Candidate ranking requires an evaluator that rejects incorrect instructions regardless of added reassurance.

next_tests.T1: Optimize reassurance wording using the current reward as the sole objective.
next_tests.T2: Validate evaluator decisions against blinded task execution on balanced correct/incorrect controls with and without reassurance.
next_tests.T3: Average the current evaluator reward across eight samples to reduce sampling variance.

scenarios.stage: Choose a follow-up candidate after a subgroup regression
scenarios.system_goal: A voice-command plugin should recognize commands across all supported dialects. Every supported dialect must retain command-success fraction of at least 0.78; improve overall success subject to that floor.

context.baseline: Across 2,000 commands the baseline succeeds on 0.86 overall and 0.81 for dialect D. Dialect D supplies 20% of traffic and remains supported.
context.pilot: The same independently labeled, stratified cases were used for each option. There are 400 dialect-D commands. The subgroup scorer is unchanged and validated.
context.focal_result: Option B raises overall success to 0.906 but reduces dialect-D success to 0.61, with a 95% subgroup interval [0.56,0.66].

constraints: Supported users cannot be removed from the denominator or routed to a screen that declines their commands.
Use stratified unseen command sets for confirmation.

next_tests.T1: Freeze the chosen routing and measure command success separately for each dialect on stratified unseen commands, including end-to-end fallback failures.
next_tests.T2: Sample the production dialect mixture without recording dialect and compare only aggregate accuracy.
next_tests.T3: Remove declined dialect-D commands before computing the confirmation accuracy.

metric_choices.M1: Minimum command-success fraction across supported dialects

scenarios.stage: Choose the next action after a useful pilot result
scenarios.system_goal: A code-navigation plugin should help developers complete change-location tasks correctly. Seek at least a 0.03 absolute task-success gain while keeping p95 response latency below 900 ms and source-reference correctness at 0.95 or higher.

context.pilot: On 32 independent paired repository tasks, a compact reranker improves task success by 0.06; the paired 95% interval is [0.02,0.10]. Candidate p95 latency is 760 ms and source-reference correctness is 0.97, versus baseline 700 ms and 0.97.
context.measurement: Each independent repository task contains multiple acceptance checks. Task success is the fraction of checks completed correctly per repository, averaged across repositories. Reference locations and the fixed rubric are independently checked; baseline and candidate use the same repository blocks.
context.focal_result: The compact reranker reports a task-success gain of 0.06 with paired 95% interval [0.02,0.10], p95 latency 760 ms, and source-reference correctness 0.97. No independent confirmation batch has run.

constraints: The independent confirmation batch has not run.
Production adoption requires the frozen candidate to clear the prespecified confirmation rule for the 0.03 gain and both guards.
Budget supports 60 new paired repository tasks.

next_tests.T1: Repeat the 32 pilot tasks until the confidence interval excludes gains below 0.03.
next_tests.T2: Change model size and reranker together, then compare only average completion token count.
next_tests.T3: Run the frozen baseline and candidate on 60 new paired repository tasks; apply the prespecified 0.03 improvement rule and check latency and source-reference correctness.
